about: The HAX network's record: one entry per property, saying what it is called, where it lives, the color and icon that stand for it, what it is for and how it relates to the rest. Everything that names, draws or describes a property reads this, so the network says one thing about itself. color and on are DDD color names (the fill, and the ink that reads on it). icon is a plain simple-icon for places that cannot draw the property's own network icon. order is the order the network bar lists them. A tool that lives within a property names it in within and is not in the network bar: RPG me is one of HAX Art's tools, a stand-alone service at its own address (rpg.art.hax.cloud, which rpg-me.hax.cloud redirects to) linked from the Art site's menu; on RPG me the bar lights up Art. repo is the haxtheweb repository each property is built and deployed from; ubiquity (webcomponents scripts/ubiquity-network.json) must account for every one of them on a release. motion is the DDD icon motion that plain icon plays; glyphMotions are the DDD glyph motions (DDDMotionGlyphNames in webcomponents d-d-d lib/DDDMotion.js) the property's own network icon plays. tile is the main web tile that stands for the property: it takes its icon, color and motion from here, and the integrity check fails when they differ.
